# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `glassfrog` MCP server pointing at GlassFrog's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://app.glassfrog.com/api/v5/mcp/core`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.0 with GlassFrog user login and dynamic client registration — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: GlassFrog's frog mark from the `GlassFrog` GitHub organization avatar.
